payload.text: Regarding the 70, mostly deprecated SRs: Can't we just delete them if other SR cover properly the re-design? This kind of staleness should not happen. This means there is a problem in the way work gets executed. Plumb should fix those problems during the design/development instead of afterwards. Understand what happens and why this happens and how to prevent this. SR overlap, SR that should be modified on new intent, SR contradiction,  missing tests,  no earlier version, failing tests should be leveraging plumb mechanisms to prevent this type of issiue.
